slides.heading: 3 steps that matter most
steps: Confirm MediaPipe and the TD transport actually work before designing anything.
Make the discrete gesture fire reliably via a classifier, not a brittle threshold alone.
Prove it survives another body and another machine, then report gaps.
slides.alt: DejaViewed carousel, slide 6 of 9. The system. 3 steps that matter most. 1. Ground truth: landmarks + transport: Confirm MediaPipe and the TD transport actually work before designing anything. 2. Gesture classifier: Make the discrete gesture fire reliably via a classifier, not a brittle threshold alone. 3. Second-person test + portability + gap report: Prove it survives another body and another machine, then report gaps.

slides.heading: How you know it worked
items: The .toe opens and runs from the committed repo on a second machine (or clean profile) with a fresh TouchDesigner+Python install, no manual rewiring.
Measured end-to-end latency (paired gesture/pixel timestamps) is under ~100ms median over 10 trials, and fps holds 30+ under live tracking with motion.

slides.heading: Jittery output: raw landmarks drive parameters with no filter
paras: the visual twitches when hands rest.
one-euro filter plus dead-zones per channel.
